ABOUT ME

Passionate About Technology & Real Solutions

I'm Asad Bukhari — a WordPress developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Not just a developer, but a problem solver who uses technology to help businesses grow and succeed.

Who I Am

Hi, I'm Asad Bukhari 👋

I'm a BS IT graduate from the University of Education Lahore, and a WordPress developer & AI automation specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan.

My journey started with curiosity about how websites work. Today, I build complete digital solutions — from business websites that bring customers, to AI-powered tools and automation workflows that save hours of manual work. Every project teaches me something new, and I bring those lessons to the next client.

What makes me different? I don't just write code. I understand business — marketing, SEO, customer psychology — so every project I build is designed to deliver real results, not just look pretty.

As a WordPress developer, I've built websites for landscaping companies, salons, spas, and technical service businesses — along with AI tools like TikSave AI and ResearchFlow AI, and the Asaan Hisaab toolkit used across Pakistan. When I'm not building client projects, I'm experimenting with AI agents and new automation ideas — because the best developer is one who never stops learning.

"The best technology is the one that solves real problems for real people."
